This article compares the incidence of [[iskaemisk-apopleksi|Iskæmisk apopleksi]] (ischemic stroke) among prevalent patients with atrial fibrillation, categorized by their [[antikoagulationsbehandling|antikoagulationsbehandling]] (anticoagulation treatment) status. The data, drawn from the [[atrieflimren-i-danmark|Atrieflimren i Danmark]] reports across three consecutive years, tracks how different treatment regimens—specifically [[doac|DOAC]], [[marevan|marevan]], a combination of both, or neither—correlate with stroke outcomes during the reporting periods [^src1] [^src2] [^src3].

**Overall Trends and Population Growth**
Across the three reporting periods, the total population of prevalent atrial fibrillation patients grew steadily from 134,810 in the 2023 report to 141,141 in the 2025 report [^src1] [^src3]. Despite this population growth, the overall rate of ischemic stroke remained remarkably flat, hovering between 0.82% and 0.83% across all three years [^src1] [^src2] [^src3]. The group receiving no anticoagulation treatment ("Hverken DOAC eller Marevan") also maintained a consistently low stroke rate, ranging from 0.53% to 0.59% over the same period [^src1] [^src2] [^src3].

**Leaders and Trailers in Stroke Incidence**
The treatment group that consistently recorded the highest incidence of ischemic stroke was the combination therapy group ("Både DOAC og Marevan"). This group's stroke rate increased over time, rising from 2.89% in the 2023 report [^src1], to 3.46% in the 2024 report [^src2], and peaking at 4.06% in the 2025 report [^src3]. Conversely, the absolute number of patients receiving this combination therapy declined over the same period, dropping from 1,488 total patients in 2023 to 812 in 2025 [^src1] [^src3]. The lowest stroke rates were generally observed in the "Hverken DOAC eller Marevan" group (0.53% in 2023) [^src1] and the "Marevan" group (0.51% in 2024) [^src2]. 

**Data Anomalies and Outliers**
A close reading of the dated sections reveals significant reporting anomalies regarding the individual [[doac|DOAC]] and [[marevan|marevan]] categories. In the 2023 report, the DOAC and Marevan rows display identical values (8,486 patients without stroke and 48 with stroke, yielding 0.56% for both), suggesting a potential duplication error in the source document [^src1]. In the 2024 report, the DOAC row mirrors the exact figures of the broader "AK-behandling" (anticoagulation treatment) row (101,313 without stroke and 902 with stroke, 0.88%), indicating that the DOAC figure may have inadvertently captured the entire anticoagulation cohort [^src2]. Finally, in the 2025 report, the DOAC row is left entirely blank, providing no data for that specific treatment category [^src3].

Further methodological details, broader epidemiological context, and additional quality indicators regarding atrial fibrillation and stroke prevention are discussed extensively throughout the supplementary sections of the annual reports [^src4] [^src5] [^src6] [^src7] [^src8] [^src9] [^src10] [^src11] [^src12] [^src13] [^src14] [^src15] [^src16] [^src17] [^src18] [^src19] [^src20] [^src21] [^src22] [^src23] [^src24] [^src25] [^src26] [^src27] [^src28] [^src29] [^src30].
